# systeam_team (Data Source)

Look up an existing team by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the team to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the team belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The team description.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the team.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the team is active.
- `slug` (String) The team slug.
